name: Apley Farm Shop Nature Trail
description: Ongoing family nature trail at Apley Farm Shop. Families follow the missing-magic-seeds story using a workbook or trail app, with wildlife facts, wood carvings and hands-on activities. Visit Telford lists the trail daily through 31 December 2026.

name: Group Mountain Bike Ride - The Wild Clee Recce
description: Guided mountain-bike ride around the Clee Hills using a mix of quieter trails and countryside routes.

name: Ludlow Food Festival – Sunday
description: Sunday at Ludlow Food Festival, open 10am–5pm local time.

name: Wellbeing Walks in Comer Woods – 13 September
description: Free ticketed wellbeing walk. Suitable for all ages; the National Trust explicitly welcomes parents/carers with children under 3 in a pram or sling. Further dates include 15 and 29 September and 11, 13 and 27 October. Parking is free for attendees.
accessibility: A Powered Mobility Vehicle is available to borrow by arrangement with Dudmaston.
age_guidance: All ages; under-3s welcome in pram or sling

name: Dudmaston Heritage Open Day – 13 September
description: Free Heritage Open Days at Dudmaston, suitable for the whole family. Confirmed free-entry dates are 13, 14, 15, 16, 17 and 20 September, 11:00–16:00.

name: Wellington Walking Festival
description: A week of walks for different abilities around Wellington, Telford and surrounding countryside.

name: Leegomery Stay and Play – 14 September
description: Free term-time Monday Stay and Play for parents/carers with children from newborn to age 3. Runs 09:30–11:00 at Leegomery Community Centre. The organiser's current listing does not state a booking requirement.

name: Bridgnorth Library Rhyme Time – 14 September
description: Free weekly rhymes, stories and songs for children up to five with parents/carers. Runs Mondays 10:00–10:30 with dates confirmed through December.

name: Shifnal Library Rhyme Time – 14 September
description: Free stories, songs and rhymes for under-5s. Runs weekly on Mondays 10:30–11:00. Drop in; no booking needed.

name: Shrewsbury Library Rhyme Time – 14 September
description: Rhymes and songs for children up to five years old with parents/carers. Free weekly Monday session; confirmed weekly dates through 26 October and beyond. Booking requirement is not stated on the official listing.
accessibility: Shrewsbury Library currently reports its lift out of order, preventing disabled access to upstairs rooms and toilet facilities.

name: Oswestry Library Rhyme Time – 14 September
description: Free half-hour Monday singing and rhymes session for under-5s. No booking required. Further confirmed weekly dates include 21 and 28 September.

name: Ludlow Library Lego Club – 14 September
description: Free term-time Monday Lego Club at Ludlow Library. Children of all ages are welcome, from Duplo beginners to experienced builders.
accessibility: Ludlow Library lists disabled access, disabled parking, disabled toilets, level entry access and a lift.

name: PODS Sensory Session – 14 September
description: Term-time PODS sensory session in a dedicated sensory room with lights, bubble tube and ball pit. Parents remain on site; adults do not require a ticket and a ticket should be booked for each child.
source_name: Telford & Wrekin SEND Local Offer / PODS

name: AFC Telford KIX – Madeley – 14 September
description: Free AFC Telford United Foundation KIX football and youth-engagement session. Qualified coaches combine football with confidence, friendship and wellbeing support. No booking is needed; just turn up.
source_name: Telford & Wrekin Council / AFC Telford United Foundation

name: Coffee and Chat, Stay and Play – Market Drayton – 15 September
description: Free weekly Early Help family drop-in with Stay and Play for babies, toddlers and pre-schoolers. Families can also get advice on parenting, housing, money worries and other support. Runs every Tuesday 09:30–12:30. Support covers children 0–19 and young people with SEND up to 25; health visitors also attend the second and fourth Tuesday of the month for ages 0–5.
age_guidance: Babies, toddlers and pre-schoolers; family support 0–19 and SEND to 25

name: Museum Babies – 15 September
description: Weekly term-time sensory-play drop-in for non-walking babies, designed to support physical and social development. Runs Tuesdays 10:00–12:00 through 20 October 2026. £3 payable on the day; no booking required.

name: Best Start Stay & Play – The Lantern – 15 September
description: New five-session PEEP Learning Together Stay & Play programme. Parent carers attend with children aged 3–4 for play, singing, reading and practical ideas supporting development at home. Runs Tuesday mornings from 15 September to 13 October, 10:00–11:30. Free place booking available through the council link.

name: Bilingual story and rhyme time – Oswestry Library – 15 September
description: English and Welsh bilingual story and rhyme time for pre-school children. Free weekly Tuesday session; no booking needed.

name: PODS Blossom & Bloom SEND Stay and Play – 15 September
description: Term-time SEND stay and play for children aged 0–5, open before or after diagnosis, at PODS Hub, 1 Hawksworth Road, Central Park, Telford.
source_name: Telford & Wrekin SEND Local Offer / PODS

name: Free EHCP Assistance – The Zone – 15 September
description: Free advice, guidance and signposting for parents and carers of children and young people with SEND who are considering or going through an Education, Health and Care needs assessment/process.
age_guidance: Parents and carers of children and young people with SEND

name: Southwater Library Bounce & Rhyme – 15 September
description: Drop-in nursery rhymes and action songs for babies and toddlers under 5 with parents/carers. Runs every Tuesday 10:30–11:00 at Southwater Library; no booking required.

name: Church Stretton Library Rhyme Time – 15 September
description: Free rhymes, stories and songs for ages 0–5. Runs every Tuesday 10:30–11:00 with confirmed weekly dates through October. No booking required.

name: Bridgnorth Early Help Stay & Play – 15 September
description: Free stay-and-play session plus Early Help information and advice on family life, parenting, housing, money worries and more. Current listing shows weekly Tuesday dates including 15, 22 and 29 September and 6 October. Early Help supports families with children 0–19 and young people with SEND up to 25.
age_guidance: Families with children 0–19; SEND support to 25

name: Wellington Library Bounce & Rhyme – 15 September
description: Drop-in nursery rhymes and action songs for babies and toddlers under 5 with parents/carers. Wellington sessions run every Tuesday 14:00–14:30 and Thursday 10:30–11:00; no booking required.

name: Free KS1 & KS2 Sports Club – The Zone – 15 September
description: Free after-school sports club for Key Stage 1 and 2, with a variety of sports and skill-building activities. Runs Tuesdays and Thursdays 15:30–16:30. The organiser asks families to book through the 4 All Foundation website.
